operations.name: shape.create
operations.description: Create a shape layer or Work Path shape. kind: rectangle, rounded-rectangle, ellipse, polygon, line, custom. Pass params {x,y,w,h} or for line {from_x,from_y,to_x,to_y}; custom can use preset_id from preset.list(kind=shape). Fill/stroke are objects using fill-layer content and stroke color/width/alignment/dash.

preset_id.description: Shape preset id for kind=custom; defaults to params.custom or star

mode.description: shape creates a layer; path and pixels draw to the active raster layer

operations.name: shape.set_props
operations.description: Edit a shape layer path/fill/stroke. Target id defaults to active shape. fill accepts the same object as shape.create; stroke accepts {color,width,opacity,alignment,dash}; path accepts Path JSON. For rectangle/rounded-rectangle shape layers, radius (uniform) or corner_radii {tl,tr,br,bl} adjusts the corner rounding parametrically (same control as the on-canvas radius handles).

radius.description: Uniform corner radius in px (rectangle/rounded-rectangle shape layers only)

corner_radii.description: Per-corner radii {tl,tr,br,bl} in px (rectangle/rounded-rectangle shape layers only)
